end.summary:
Practised multiplying numbers ending in zeros by multiplying non-zero parts and counting zeros.
One of two attempts on this skill was correct without help.
Practised using powers of 10 to judge product size and digit count; the attempt was incorrect.
The zero-counting mix-up in 500 × 60 = 3,000 remained at the end; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised separating the non-zero parts and then counting the zeros, along with checking product size using powers of 10. Rudra correctly identified that 25 × 4 = 100, but the extra zeros in products such as 500 × 60 were still mixed up and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, practise a few examples by writing the non-zero multiplication first, then counting every zero in both factors before checking the answer.

skills.skill: Multiply numbers ending in zeros by multiplying the non-zero parts and counting zeros
Use powers of 10 to judge the size and number of digits of a product

misconceptions.belief: Drops a zero when the non-zero parts already make a number ending in 0 (500 × 60 = 3,000)
